title: New US Tariffs Create Fresh Challenges for Global Businesses
subtitle: As trade rules change quickly, companies struggle to plan for the future while experts question the effectiveness of these policies.

summary.en: The United States has introduced a new series of tariffs on goods from over 80 countries. These taxes, ranging from 10% to 12.5%, are intended to address concerns about forced labor in global supply chains. Business leaders argue that such frequent policy changes make it difficult to set prices and manage operations. Experts note that these measures have not yet succeeded in bringing manufacturing jobs back to the United States. Companies are now dealing with the financial and logistical consequences of this unpredictable trade environment.
summary.zh: 美國已針對超過八十個國家的商品實施新一輪關稅。這些稅率介於百分之十至百分之十二點五之間的稅款，旨在解決全球供應鏈中關於強迫勞動的疑慮。企業領袖認為，如此頻繁的政策變動使得定價與營運管理變得困難。專家指出，這些措施尚未成功將製造業工作帶回美國。企業目前正致力於應對這種不可預測的貿易環境所帶來的財務與物流後果。

paragraphs.en: The United States government has launched a new series of tariffs—taxes on imported goods—affecting products from more than 80 countries. These new measures, which range from 10% to 12.5%, follow the expiration of a previous set of import taxes. According to NPR Business, the administration claims these new rules are necessary to punish countries that fail to stop the use of forced labor within their supply chains. However, for many business owners, this latest development represents another layer of instability in an already difficult global market.
paragraphs.zh: 美國政府已啟動新一輪關稅（即針對進口商品徵收的稅款），影響範圍涵蓋超過八十個國家的產品。這些新措施的稅率介於百分之十至百分之十二點五之間，是在前一批進口稅到期後所實施的。根據美國公共廣播電台（NPR）商業新聞報導，政府聲稱這些新規定是為了懲罰那些未能阻止供應鏈中使用強迫勞動的國家。然而，對許多企業主而言，這項最新發展在原本就已艱困的全球市場中，又增添了一層不穩定因素。

paragraphs.en: For companies that rely on international trade, the constant changes in policy are creating a "dangerous game of pressure" that makes long-term planning nearly impossible. Jay Foreman, CEO of the toy company Basic Fun!, described the situation as a repetitive cycle of uncertainty. In an interview with NPR Business, Foreman explained that businesses cannot set clear pricing or policies when the rules change so frequently. He noted that previous trade conflicts have already caused significant disruptions, including lost sales and inventory issues that are difficult to recover from, even if the government eventually returns some of the money paid in tariffs.
paragraphs.zh: 對於仰賴國際貿易的公司來說，政策的不斷變動創造了一場「危險的壓力遊戲」，使得長期規劃幾乎變得不可能。玩具公司 Basic Fun! 的執行長佛曼（Jay Foreman）將這種情況描述為一個反覆出現的不確定性循環。佛曼在接受 NPR 商業新聞採訪時解釋說，當規則變動如此頻繁時，企業根本無法制定明確的定價或政策。他指出，先前的貿易衝突已經造成了嚴重的干擾，包括銷售損失和庫存問題，即便政府最終退還部分已繳納的關稅，這些損失也難以彌補。

paragraphs.en: This is not the first time the current administration has used tariffs as a primary tool in international relations. Over the past 18 months, businesses have faced multiple rounds of trade restrictions. While the administration frames these actions as a way to protect labor standards, many in the business community remain skeptical. Foreman argued that the explanation provided by the government does not fully justify the broad impact these taxes have on so many different nations and industries. He emphasized that the real-world cost of these policies is often felt by companies trying to grow their businesses and support their employees.
paragraphs.zh: 這並非現任政府首次將關稅作為國際關係的主要工具。在過去十八個月裡，企業已經面臨多輪貿易限制。儘管政府將這些行動包裝為維護勞動標準的手段，但商界許多人仍持懷疑態度。佛曼主張，政府提供的解釋並不足以完全合理化這些稅收對眾多國家與產業所造成的廣泛影響。他強調，這些政策在現實世界中的代價，往往是由那些試圖擴展業務並支持員工的公司所承擔。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the immediate financial impact on companies, there is a broader question about whether these trade policies are achieving their stated goals. One of the main arguments for using tariffs has been the hope that they would encourage companies to move their manufacturing operations back to the United States. However, data suggests this has not happened. Evan Smith, CEO of Altana, a company that uses software to track global supply chains, told The Verge that the expected return of manufacturing jobs to the US has not materialized. According to Smith, the global economy remains deeply connected, and these policies have only made the existing networks more complex and difficult to manage.
paragraphs.zh: 除了對公司造成的直接財務影響外，更廣泛的問題在於這些貿易政策是否達成了其宣稱的目標。使用關稅的主要論點之一，是希望藉此鼓勵企業將製造業務遷回美國。然而，數據顯示這種情況並未發生。利用軟體追蹤全球供應鏈的 Altana 公司執行長史密斯（Evan Smith）告訴科技媒體 The Verge，預期中的製造業工作回流美國並未實現。根據史密斯的說法，全球經濟依然緊密相連，而這些政策只讓現有的網絡變得更加複雜且難以管理。

paragraphs.en: As trade rules change rapidly, companies are finding it harder to keep up with the current requirements. Smith noted that the combination of unpredictable tariff policies and geopolitical conflicts, such as the war in Iran, has created a chaotic environment for international trade. Because the rules can change almost daily, businesses are forced to rely on advanced tools and data to understand what is happening across their supply chains. This "new normal" of global trade means that companies must be more flexible than ever before, as they can no longer rely on the stable systems that defined international business in the past.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著貿易規則迅速變動，企業發現越來越難以跟上當前的要求。史密斯指出，不可預測的關稅政策與地緣政治衝突（例如伊朗的戰爭）相結合，為國際貿易創造了一個混亂的環境。由於規則幾乎每天都可能改變，企業被迫仰賴先進的工具與數據，以了解供應鏈中發生的狀況。這種全球貿易的「新常態」意味著公司必須比以往更加靈活，因為他們已無法再依賴過去定義國際商業的那種穩定體系。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the outlook for global trade remains uncertain. While some companies have successfully applied for refunds on tariffs that were later found to be illegal, the time and momentum lost during these trade disputes cannot be replaced. As the administration continues to use tariffs to exert pressure on other nations, businesses are left to navigate the consequences. For now, the focus for many remains on survival and adaptation, as they wait to see if the current trade environment will stabilize or if further changes are on the horizon. The debate over whether these measures are an effective way to address labor issues or simply a burden on the economy is likely to continue as long as the tariffs remain in place.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，全球貿易的前景依然不明朗。雖然有些公司已成功申請退回後來被認定為非法的關稅，但在這些貿易爭端中失去的時間與發展動能卻無法挽回。隨著政府持續利用關稅對其他國家施壓，企業只能自行應對後果。目前，許多企業的焦點仍放在生存與適應上，等待觀察當前的貿易環境是否會趨於穩定，或是未來還會有更多變動。只要這些關稅持續存在，關於這些措施究竟是解決勞動問題的有效途徑，還是僅僅加重經濟負擔的爭論，預計將會持續下去。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To present or describe something in a particular way to influence how others perceive it.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 將某事描述或呈現為某種樣子，藉此影響他人的觀點。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（框架、畫框），這裡作動詞用。文中：While the administration frames these actions as a way to protect labor standards, many in the business community remain skeptical.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To become actual or real; to happen as expected.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 實現、成為現實；指預期的事情發生。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於科幻作品（物體顯現），這裡指預期的結果沒有發生。文中：Evan Smith, CEO of Altana, a company that uses software to track global supply chains, told The Verge that the expected return of manufacturing jobs to the US has not materialized.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To move or progress at the same speed as something else; to stay informed about something.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 跟上（進度或變化）；及時了解最新情況。
keyTerms.noteZh: 由動詞與介系詞組成，意思非字面直譯。文中：As trade rules change rapidly, companies are finding it harder to keep up with the current requirements.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Likely to happen or appear soon.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 即將發生；在不久的將來。
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面意為「在地平線上」，引申為即將到來的事件。文中：For now, the focus for many remains on survival and adaptation, as they wait to see if the current trade environment will stabilize or if further changes are on the horizon.

quiz.question: What is the specific reason the U.S. administration provides for implementing the current series of tariffs?

options.A: To encourage companies to move their manufacturing operations back to the United States.
options.B: To penalize nations that do not effectively address forced labor in their supply chains.
options.C: To generate government revenue to offset losses from previous trade conflicts.
options.D: To respond to geopolitical conflicts such as the ongoing war in Iran.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，政府明確指出這些新措施是為了懲罰那些未能阻止供應鏈中使用強迫勞動的國家。選項 A 是文章第四段提到的「目標」之一，但並非政府針對此次特定關稅所提出的官方理由。選項 C 是錯誤推論，文章未提到關稅是為了增加稅收以彌補損失。選項 D 雖在第五段提到伊朗戰爭，但那是導致貿易環境混亂的因素之一，而非實施關稅的官方理由。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, what is a likely consequence for a company that frequently deals with international trade under these new policies?

options.A: They will likely see an increase in profit margins due to government tariff refunds.
options.B: They will be able to simplify their supply chains by moving operations to the U.S.
options.C: They will face increased operational costs and difficulty in long-term financial forecasting.
options.D: They will be forced to cease all international business activities to avoid legal penalties.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第二段與第五段，頻繁變動的貿易政策導致企業無法設定明確的價格或政策，且必須依賴昂貴的數據工具來應對複雜的供應鏈，這直接導致了長期規劃的困難與營運成本增加。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到即便能獲得退款，也無法彌補失去的時間與業務動能。選項 B 與文章第四段提到的數據矛盾，製造業並未如預期回流。選項 D 過於極端，文章強調的是「生存與適應」，而非停止所有業務。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, the phrase 'the expected return of manufacturing jobs to the US has not materialized' suggests that the return of these jobs:

options.A: Did not actually happen as predicted.
options.C: Was a secret plan kept by the administration.
options.D: Was successfully completed ahead of schedule.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境下，「materialize」意指「實現」或「成為現實」。作者使用此詞是為了表達政府所期望的製造業回流並沒有真的發生。選項 B 錯誤，因為文章並未討論其物理可行性。選項 C 無中生有，文章並未暗示這是一個秘密計畫。選項 D 與文章內容直接相反，文章明確指出數據顯示製造業並未回流。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding the recent U.S. tariff policies?

options.A: The policies have successfully forced other nations to improve their labor standards.
options.B: The policies are a temporary measure that will soon be replaced by a more stable trade agreement.
options.C: The policies are widely supported by business owners as a necessary evil for global trade.
options.D: The policies have created significant uncertainty and challenges for businesses without achieving their intended economic goals.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。本文主旨探討了關稅政策對企業造成的負面衝擊，包括不確定性、營運困難，以及數據顯示這些政策並未達到鼓勵製造業回流等預期目標。選項 A 與文章第四段矛盾，成效未顯現。選項 B 錯誤，文章結尾提到未來仍充滿不確定性，並未暗示即將有穩定的協議。選項 C 完全錯誤，文中明確提到企業主對這些政策持懷疑態度，並認為其對經濟造成沉重負擔。
